EventFlow · implementation plan · 11 Oct 2026

Desktop web and the organizer console

The customer app moves from phone to a 1440 × 900 desktop page, and Chai gets a working console. 12 tasks: 1 shared foundation, 5 parallel lanes (at most 3 at once), and 1 join at the end.

Decisions I took · hard to undo later

Decisions to check

Two pages on one server

/ is Kenji's app and /organizer.html is Chai's. They share one router and one fake, so a tier Chai adds is a tier Kenji can buy.

A new OrganizerGateway

It is a second switch next to BookingGateway. When the teammate's core is ready, CoreOrganizerGateway replaces the fake. The page stays the same.

Undesigned screens get built

SCR-34c–f and SCR-35–40 follow the docs text in the same look. Otherwise UC-06 and UC-07 would have no screen at all.

No phone layout

The page works from 1024 px wide upward. docs/08 changes to a 1440 × 900 desktop, with a new ASM-10.

The carousel goes

The web design uses one hero card and a 3-column grid with search. Yesterday's carousel is removed.

Native date and time inputs

The design draws custom pickers. Native inputs styled to match are much less code and still accept times to the second.
